stop_rule: Stop later cells on route drift, process/network failure, malformed envelope, schema-invalid output, unfinished ledger event, budget/order error, static/source drift, or artifact collision.
continue_rule: Continue after structurally valid membership failure or structurally valid zero candidates.
interpretation_rule: Any zero-candidate run or structural/infrastructure incompleteness is INCOMPLETE_MATRIX. Combined gain requires finite non-null p1-s2 and p0-s0 rates in every paired repetition, p1-s2 greater in all three pairs, p1-s2 at 3/3 fully conformant informative runs, and p0-s0 below 3/3. NO_OBSERVED_DIFFERENCE requires all four conditions and all 12 informative runs; otherwise a complete informative matrix is mixed.
